Computational Natural Language Processing Study

Abstract

We developed a machine learning algorithm for automated classification of scientific text using natural language processing.

The model was evaluated using precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy.

Methods

The computational framework was implemented in Python using machine learning and natural language processing libraries.

The algorithm was trained and evaluated using publicly available textual datasets.

Model performance was evaluated using precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy.

No human participants were involved in this study.

Code and Data Availability

The source code used for the computational analysis is publicly available on GitHub.

The datasets used in this study are publicly available and can be accessed through the project repository.
